//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder'ın 2026-10-01 çift bağımsız inceleme talimatının sınırlı review-governance yükseltme paketini kaydeder: CLAUDE_REVIEWER + CODEX_REVIEWER, iki CLEAN yeter sayısı, sağlayıcı atıflı bulgu birleştirme, ayrı kota durumları, izole ve salt-okunur Claude reviewer; tam depo son denetimi PKG-DR2'dedir.
founderDirective: Founder directive 2026-10-01 (ADD CLAUDE AS A SECOND INDEPENDENT REVIEW PROVIDER): every governed review package must also receive an independent Claude review; this must not mean that the Claude builder reviews its own work; CLAUDE_REVIEWER runs as a separate Claude process/session in an isolated clean review clone at the frozen commit/base/bundle digest with read-only permissions narrower than the builder, a fresh adversarial prompt and a separate run/evidence directory; distinct identities CLAUDE_REVIEWER and CODEX_REVIEWER with separate provenance; merge requires both CLEAN, any valid BLOCKED blocks, malformed review is REVIEW_INVALID, quota is REVIEW_PENDING_PROVIDER without cycle consumption; findings aggregated with provider attribution; remediation then review by both again; separate Claude/Codex reviewer quota states; reviews only after the commit is immutable and the bundle frozen; historical Codex CLEAN evidence stays valid and open packages get the Claude review in addition; final release closure needs CLEAN Claude and Codex full-repository reviews of the same candidate; the supervisor orchestrates everything; use the authenticated Claude Code installation, no Anthropic API key without separate approval, no silent reviewer identity change; implement as a bounded review-governance upgrade package, review it under the existing valid mechanism, then activate DUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

founderAuthorization.rule: Explicit Founder package directive of 2026-10-01; the protected files strictly necessary for the bounded review-governance upgrade are authorized; every change keeps or strengthens trust (the Codex contract is unchanged and both reviews are required).
protectedFiles: scripts/autonomy-hardening-selftest.mjs (instrumented Claude reviewer substitute and dual-policy expectations)
founderAuthorization.constraint: bounded to dual package review; the final full-repository release audit is the follow-up package PKG-DR2; no Anthropic API key; Codex reviewer contract unchanged; no weakening of trust, provenance, evidence, Global Stop or fail-closed behavior

split: The directive was implemented as two bounded packages to keep each review reviewable: PKG-DR1 (sections 1-11, 13-17: dual package review) and PKG-DR2 (section 12 and its test: CLAUDE_FULL_REPO_REVIEW + CODEX_FULL_REPO_REVIEW before final release closure).

design.quorum: automation/lib/review-quorum.mjs: requiredReviewers (DUAL after activation or when marked; CODEX_ONLY_HISTORICAL kept), currentGate keyed by bundle digest and cycle (stale on change; an earlier Codex-only CLEAN on the same bundle is carried into the Codex gate), computeReviewAggregate, nextReviewer, aggregateFindings (exact file+symbol+category merge with attribution; each provider evidence carries its full governed finding so remediation gets no less than before; aggregate id = provider-namespaced finding id), mergeFindingLedgers (provider-namespaced ids; fingerprints do not include ids)
design.broker: scripts/claude-reviewer-broker.mjs + automation/lib/claude-reviewer.mjs: control-plane broker, policy and system prompt; launcher provenance from the review clone; -p --restricted --model <pinned> --tools Read,Glob,Grep --disallowedTools ... --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence --disable-slash-commands --append-system-prompt-file ... --output-format json; never --continue/--resume/--session-id; fallback only if configured (null); reviewer text to stdout, observed model/session to one stderr line
design.pipeline: automation/lib/review-pipeline.mjs: runBrokerReview/findCompletedRun/evaluateReviewRun/writeEnvironmentBlock are provider-aware (identity, process boundary, separate stdout/stderr files and run directories); governReviewText keeps the Codex checks and adds the Claude checks (builder identity differs, Anthropic, claude tool, SUFFICIENT independence, observed model equals the configured model or a dated release, tool version); rederiveGovernedFromEvidence uses the recorded identity; Claude limit formats parsed
design.engine: automation/lib/orchestrator-engine.mjs: per-reviewer REVIEW actions with per-reviewer provider states (claudeReviewer separate from the claude builder); applyDualReview (quota -> PROVIDER_BLOCKED without cycle/format consumption; FORMAT_REJECTED per reviewer, INVALID after the limit -> Founder decision; quorum; BLOCKED -> remediation with aggregated findings or the cycle limit); COMMITTED resets the gate and marks DUAL after activation; codex-CLEAN open packages get the Claude review before merging; REVIEW_CLEAN skips the missing-reviewer step only for a dual-clean review of the current bundle
design.executors: automation/lib/orchestrator-executors.mjs: reviewDual (own clean clone per reviewer, adoption by reviewer identity, post-run review-tree check, per-reviewer evidence and ledger), dual merge gate (both evidences re-derived with their identity and bound to the frozen bundle), merged remediation ledger
design.activation: automation/lib/orchestrator-daemon.mjs + scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs: DUAL_REVIEW_ACTIVATED recorded once with the control-plane commit when the running plane's policy sets dualReviewRequired
design.model: reviewers.claude.model = claude-opus-5, the exact id observed from the authenticated installation (a probe of 'claude-opus-5-5' returned unrecognized_model; the 'opus' alias resolved to claude-opus-5 and the exact id answered); no fallback

tests: scripts/dual-review-selftest.mjs (17 scenarios) via tests/pkg-dr1-dual-review.test.ts: quorum incl. INVALID/PENDING/PROVIDER_BLOCKED, aggregation and namespaced ledgers, stale gate on commit or digest change, engine both-CLEAN merge, Claude CLEAN + Codex BLOCKED and Claude BLOCKED + Codex CLEAN block, remediation re-review by both, refrozen bundle re-review, Claude quota without cycle consumption and automatic retry, malformed Claude review never CLEAN, restart without duplicate provider call, activation and history, isolated read-only reviewer process without builder session variables, identical frozen scope with separate evidence, builder impersonation refused (process boundary, missing observed provenance, identity equal to the builder, wrong provider, insufficient independence, changed model), reviewer cannot modify the source, Claude quota evidence and malformed output, merge requires both evidences with the right identities. The AUT2 autonomy-hardening selftest (17/17) now runs its daemon scenarios under the active dual policy: an instrumented Claude reviewer substitute (separate call log) answers like the Codex substitute; scenario C additionally asserts that the Claude CLEAN of the same bundle is kept and not repeated while Codex waits for its quota, H that the Codex BLOCKED is recorded with its own ledger and the cycle-2 ledger carries the provider-namespaced id, and the CLI fixture package is a dual-clean review.
